description: A stereo switch that works out for itself whether it is a two-to-one switch, a one-to-two router, a signal swapper, a mute, a flip flop or a toggled gate, from which jacks have cables in them

params.text: Chooses whether the T/G jack is read as a gate that holds the switch over, or as triggers that flip it each time
Sets how long the crossfade between the two states takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant

inputs.text: Flips the switch: held above 1V in Gate mode, or one trigger to flip and the next to flip back in Toggle mode
A trigger here returns the switch to its resting state
The left channel of the first signal; the function the module performs is worked out from the left jacks alone
The right channel of the first signal
The left channel of the second signal
The right channel of the second signal
Lengthens the crossfade by one second per volt, added to the FADE knob, with the total held between 0 and 10 seconds

outputs.text: The left channel of the first destination
The right channel of the first destination
The left channel of the second destination
The right channel of the second destination

notes: the module reads its function off the cables: two inputs and one output make a switch, one input and two outputs make a router.
two inputs and two outputs make a swapper, one input and one output a mute, two outputs alone a flip flop, and one output alone a toggled gate.
only the left jacks are examined when working out the function, so a right channel patched without its left one is not seen.
menu: Initialize on Start — comes up in its resting state when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming whatever state it was saved in

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
